description: Draft SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence responses per Vanta control using an LLM.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of Vanta controls

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var containing the LLM provider API key

control_description_column.description: Column holding the control description text
control_description_column.label: Control Description Column

context_column.label: Context Column

response_column.description: Column name to write the draft response into
response_column.label: Response Column

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt setting the compliance-analyst persona.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Cap the number of rows processed (useful for testing / cost control)

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps
